Generated from public declarations in `walz:core`, implemented in `walz/core/`. Update with `just stdlib-docs` and verify with `just check-stdlib-docs`.
Select names explicitly, for example `(@use "walz:core" (type $string) (func $string.u64))`.
Apply generics with `(@inst $name T...)`. Omitting a result declaration means unit.

`pure` means an empty semantic effect set, not a guarantee of trap freedom, termination, or zero physical allocation.
An unannotated generic has no declared effect restriction; each specialization is checked for types, effects, and ownership.
